title: U.S. Budget Deficit Nears $2 Trillion, a Reality Check for Trump’s Cost Cutting
partialText: Higher interest rates are inflating borrowing costs as the Trump administration spends on the Iran war and tariff refunds.

title: You’ve Found a Long-Lost CD. Can You Still Get Your Money?

title: Indonesian Stocks Plunge as MSCI Threatens to Drop Market from Indexes
